contract: ScenarioCompareRequest: two sides, each {profile_id, portfolio_strategy}. portfolio_strategy is null (the application's default, risk-conditioned choice) or one of mvo, hrp, equal_weight -- the only parameter the simulator lets a client vary.
profile_id_resolution: persona_demo_key -> the persona's customer id, found by exact name at run time (GET /api/profiles/lookup). No numeric id is stored here.
outputs: Computed by the application for each side (the same analysis pipeline) -- never stored here. A strategy that has not been run for that persona before is computed and cached as a new analysis; the persona's default analysis is unchanged.

scenarios.title: Current assumptions: the default strategy beside MVO
scenarios.shows: The simulator's starting point: the application's default choice beside an explicit MVO run.

scenarios.title: Two construction methods: MVO beside HRP
scenarios.shows: Mean-variance optimisation and hierarchical risk parity for the same customer.

scenarios.title: A method beside the simple benchmark: HRP beside 1/N
scenarios.shows: Hierarchical risk parity beside the equal-weight (1/N) benchmark.

scenarios.title: Savings first: the default strategy beside HRP
scenarios.shows: How the application treats a strategy choice when the emergency fund is insufficient -- the application decides, the scenario only asks.

scenarios.title: Compliance: the default strategy beside MVO
scenarios.shows: Whether a strategy choice changes a compliance rejection -- the compliance gate decides, the scenario only asks.

not_supported_by_the_contract.why: contribution_amount is a stored financial input (PUT /api/profiles/{id}/financial-inputs), not a simulator parameter. A what-if would need a new API; changing it on a demo persona would change that persona's stored data.
The same as for a lower contribution.
monthly_essential_expenses is a stored financial input, not a simulator parameter -- the same limitation.
target_date is a stored goal field, not a simulator parameter; the simulator varies the portfolio strategy only.
